traditional: A soft contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts supports limitation, delay, and hard structure - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Mind meets discipline. Serious, deep, careful thinking; apparent slowness that is caution, not lack of intelligence. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Rigor, depth, and thoroughness. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize thinking and limit into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what thinking and limit have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: A delayed answer moves after someone supplies the missing proof in exactly the required form.
readerCopy.body: A delayed answer moves after someone supplies the missing proof in exactly the required form. One document, corrected line, signature, or responsible contact gives the reviewer enough support to release part of the request. Mercury identifies the information holding the decision back, while Saturn determines what can be authorized and entered into the record. The sextile opens a narrow route through the restriction, but someone still has to meet the condition. The result may be smaller than first requested, yet the portion that clears is solid enough to rely on.
